name: error-filter-kind-mismatch-jsonb
$comment: SEC-126 typing on the jsonb path: a filter value whose JSON kind does not match a declared-but-NOT-indexed field's type is rejected with BAD_REQUEST ('filter on field X value kind does not match declared field type') — gt(5) on a String field would otherwise compile to (doc->>'note')::float8, which Postgres evaluates per row and errors on the first non-numeric stored value: a fan-out subscription re-run that fails forever and silently never pushes (the failure SEC-126 closed). `note` is optional<string>, so the Optional wrapper is unwrapped before the kind check. Mirrors server query/filter.rs validate_jsonb_comparison_value.
